Research

RESEARCH / NYU COURSE PROJECT

JEPA World Model

An end-to-end implementation and training workflow for future latent-state prediction, developed for the NYU Deep Learning course, September–December 2024.

Model diagram, prediction video, and evaluation plots to be added.

Approach

The recurrent variant combines image sequences with action inputs to predict future latent states. The work spans model implementation and the training workflow.

Training & evaluation

The workflow uses VICReg/BYOL-style regularization constraints and probe-based evaluation to examine the learned representations. This is a course project.

AI-Generated Code & Technical Debt

A system for analyzing technical debt in AI-generated code, combining code analysis with a practical data-processing workflow.

The system

The AI-Generated Code Technical Debt Analysis System brings static analysis and visualization together to examine technical debt in generated software.

Approach

The project uses Python and Dask for processing, with Git and Docker in the workflow. Static analysis provides material for inspection and visualization.
